tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and card background. Text on it uses ink, sub or meta.

tokens.name: stopped
tokens.usage: Background of a rail group and of a stopped card. Text on it uses ink or sub.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground and stopped.

tokens.name: sub
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground and stopped, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Meta lines and counts on ground (4.5:1 light, 6:1 dark). Not for body text.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Uppercase group labels on stopped and ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of cards, inputs and the rail.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the rail and between rows.

tokens.name: chip-count
tokens.usage: Fill of count chips and the Mine / Everyone switch.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action in a view: New session, Resume, Take it, Assign. White (light) or action-ink (dark) text on it.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Text on action. 4.8:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Brand orange: focus ring, the open session's outline. Never for text.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the brand orange on amber-tint and ground.

tokens.name: amber-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted background for an orange note or an outlined orange button.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: A session that needs a person: Needs you, Paused, Waiting. Also a PR chip in the merge queue, on a 12% wash of itself, with the word queued, as GitHub colors it. Text and dot on ground and stopped (4.8:1 or more). Always with the word.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Working, in review, waiting on a job, links and the Assigned outline. Text on ground and slate-tint.

tokens.name: slate-tint
tokens.usage: Background for slate chips.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done, finished, a passing PR. Text and dots on ground.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failed, a failing PR check. Always with a word or the ✗ mark.

tokens.name: private
tokens.usage: Fill of the Private tag. Text on it is private-ink.

tokens.name: private-ink
tokens.usage: Text on private. 12:1 light, 7:1 dark.

tokens.name: proj-teal
tokens.usage: A project's colour, one of six in the palette Console settings offers (1 of 6). The first repo with no colour picked takes it. The 3px left edge of its cards on the rail, the swatch on its filter chip and on the Repos card. Identity only, never a status, and never alone: the project's name is in the card's tooltip and on the chip. 4.5:1 or more on ground, stopped and its tint, in both themes.

tokens.name: proj-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of proj-teal's filter chip while it is picked. Text on it is ink (13:1 or more) or sub (4.9:1 or more), in both themes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The page title only (Shared page, settings pages).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A session's title on its rail card; 12px weight 500 once stopped.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The second line of a card: PR chip, status word, who, how long.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a group and between head controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rail head and card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rail buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rail cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count chips and the People filter.

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Cards use borders, not shadows.
